text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the south side of Bedford Park Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the south side of Bedford Park Avenue, between a point 45.7 metres east of Elm Road and a point 5.5 metres further east.
